headword: {数十億円|すうじゅうおくえん}

issues.concern: The gloss is misleading. 数十億円 means 'several tens of hundreds of millions of yen', which is 'several billions of yen', not 'several billion yen'. 'Several billion yen' would be 数十億ドル (suujuuoku doru).
issues.suggestion: several tens of hundreds of millions of yen; several billions of yen
